lines.text: Jesus sees a large crowd and orders a crossing of the sea, and a scribe offers to follow Him.
Jesus tells the scribe foxes have dens and birds have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay His head.
A disciple asks to first bury his mother, but Jesus says to follow Him and let the dead bury theirs.
Jesus gets into the boat and a violent storm engulfs it, but He is praying until the disciples wake Him.
Jesus rebukes the winds and sea, it becomes perfectly calm, and the amazed men ask what kind of man this is.
